metaTitle: Custom Swimming Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom swimming lanyards and badges for bulk orders. Perfect for pools, teams, and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom swimming lanyards and badges are built to withstand chlorine, saltwater, and constant splashing. Unlike standard lanyards that fray or fade, these use waterproof materials like silicone or coated polyester. HR directors and safety managers use them for pool staff ID, swim meet credentials, or locker room access. Add your logo with heat transfer or screen printing for a durable finish that stays legible season after season.
heroAltText: Stack of custom swimming lanyards and badges with colorful straps and clear ID holders, ideal for pool use.
